answer: A sybil-resistant agent market can use slow-vested reputation stake: each identity must lock collateral that vests like a glacier, moving only gradually toward full trading rights, while every transaction leaves a crystal audit trail linking payments to verified work. New identities start with an umber-level cap on order size, rising only after sustained honest deliveries; creating thousands of fake accounts then requires funding each cap separately and waiting through the vesting delay, while a single fraud triggers slashing of the locked stake across all linked accounts.
